Description:
Experience superior cleaning performance with Smart Matic washing machine detergent powder, specially formulated with SPF (Smart Protection Formula) technology. This innovative powder delivers powerful stain removal while protecting your clothes' colours through multiple washes. The quick-rinsing formula ensures no residue is left behind, while the delightful lavender fragrance leaves your laundry smelling fresh and clean. Available in convenient 3kg value pack and 5kg super saver pack options, this detergent is specifically designed for modern Indian households using washing machines. The Smart Protection Formula works effectively to remove tough stains while being gentle on fabrics, making it suitable for regular use. Perfect for busy families looking for reliable, high-quality laundry care at an affordable price point. The powder dissolves completely in water, preventing any powder residue on clothes and ensuring thorough cleaning in every wash.

  • SPF TECHNOLOGY: Features Smart Protection Formula (SPF) technology for powerful stain removal and colour protection while being gentle on fabrics
